real64 median(real64[] values)
    ordered := values.sorted()
    length := int(#ordered)
    return if length % 2 == 1 then ordered[length / 2] else (ordered[length / 2 - 1] + ordered[length / 2]) / 2.0

class Flat(int first, int last, int value)
class Prepared(int first, int last, int[] numeric_times, int[] reasons, Flat[] flat_runs, int[] candidates)

Prepared prepare_record(bool[] present, bool[] numeric, int[] values, int minimum_run)
    numeric_times := [for t := (0:<int(#values))[] if numeric[t] then t]
    first := numeric_times[0]
    last := numeric_times[-1]
    reasons := [for t := (0:<int(#values))[] then (if not present[t] then 1 elif not numeric[t] then 2 else 0)]
    Flat[] flat_runs := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#numeric_times)
        start := numeric_times[cursor]
        end := start
        while cursor + 1 < int(#numeric_times) and numeric_times[cursor + 1] == end + 1 and values[numeric_times[cursor + 1]] == values[start]
            cursor += 1
            end = numeric_times[cursor]
        if end - start + 1 >= minimum_run
            flat_runs = flat_runs.append(Flat(start, end, values[start]))
            for: start + 1 <= t <= end
                reasons[t] = 3
        cursor += 1
    candidates := [for t := numeric_times[] if reasons[t] == 0 then t]
    return Prepared(first, last, numeric_times, reasons, flat_runs, candidates)

class Spike(int hour, real64 residual, real64 center, real64 mad, real64 limit)
class Tests(int tested, Spike[] spikes)

Tests detect_spikes(int[] candidates, real64[] preliminary_residuals, int window, int required, real64 factor, real64 floor_limit)
    Spike[] spikes := []
    tested := 0
    lower := 0
    upper := 0
    for t := candidates[]
        while lower < int(#candidates) and candidates[lower] < t - window
            lower += 1
        while upper < int(#candidates) and candidates[upper] <= t + window
            upper += 1
        if upper - lower < required
            continue
        tested += 1
        neighbours := [for i := (int(lower):<int(upper))[] then preliminary_residuals[candidates[i]]]
        center := median(neighbours)
        mad := median([for value := neighbours[] then absolute(value - center)])
        limit := factor * 1.4826 * mad
        if limit < floor_limit
            limit = floor_limit
        residual := preliminary_residuals[t]
        if absolute(residual - center) > limit
            spikes = spikes.append(Spike(t, residual, center, mad, limit))
    return Tests(tested, spikes)

class Gap(int first, int last, int reason)

Gap[] list_gaps(int first, int last, int[] reasons)
    Gap[] gaps := []
    start := first
    while start <= last
        if reasons[start] == 0
            start += 1
            continue
        end := start
        cause := reasons[start]
        while end + 1 <= last and reasons[end + 1] != 0
            end += 1
            if reasons[end] != cause
                cause = 5
        gaps = gaps.append(Gap(start, end, cause))
        start = end + 1
    return gaps

import math

const real64 pi := 3.141592653589793

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

real64 arctangent(real64 value)
    invert := value > 1.0
    z := if invert then 1.0 / value else value
    reduce := z > 0.41421356237309503
    if reduce
        z = (z - 1.0) / (z + 1.0)
    squared := z * z
    power := z
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: j < 40
        result += power / real64(2 * j + 1)
        power *= -squared
    if reduce
        result += pi / 4.0
    return if invert then pi / 2.0 - result else result

real64 phase(real64 a, real64 b)
    real64 radians := 0.0
    if a == 0.0
        radians = if b >= 0.0 then pi / 2.0 else -pi / 2.0
    else
        ratio := b / a
        radians = arctangent(absolute(ratio))
        if ratio < 0.0
            radians = -radians
        if a < 0.0
            radians += if b >= 0.0 then pi else -pi
    degrees := radians * 180.0 / pi
    return if degrees < 0.0 then degrees + 360.0 else degrees

real64 angle(real64 speed, real64 hour)
    degrees := speed * hour
    turns := math.floor(degrees / 360.0)
    reduced := degrees - 360.0 * real64(turns)
    return reduced * pi / 180.0

real64[] regressors(real64 hour, real64[] speeds)
    real64[] result := [1.0]
    for speed := speeds[]
        theta := angle(speed, hour)
        result = result.concat([math.cos(theta), math.sin(theta)])
    return result

class Model(real64[] coefficients, real64[][] inverse, real64[] amplitudes, real64[] phases)

Model fit(real64[] values, int[] times, real64[] speeds)
    dimension := 2 * int(#speeds) + 1
    real64[][] matrix := [for i := (0:<int(dimension))[] then [for j := (0:<int(dimension))[] then 0.0]]
    real64[] right := [for i := (0:<int(dimension))[] then 0.0]
    for t := times[]
        vector := regressors(real64(t), speeds)
        for: i < dimension
            right[i] += vector[i] * values[t]
            for: j < dimension
                matrix[i][j] += vector[i] * vector[j]
    real64[][] augmented := [for i := (0:<int(dimension))[] then matrix[i].append(right[i]).concat([for j := (0:<int(dimension))[] then (if i == j then 1.0 else 0.0)])]
    for: column < dimension
        pivot := column
        for: column + 1 <= i < dimension
            if absolute(augmented[i][column]) > absolute(augmented[pivot][column])
                pivot = i
        if pivot != column
            previous := augmented[column]
            augmented[column] = augmented[pivot]
            augmented[pivot] = previous
        for: column + 1 <= row < dimension
            factor := augmented[row][column] / augmented[column][column]
            for: column <= c <= 2 * dimension
                augmented[row][c] -= factor * augmented[column][c]
    real64[][] solutions := []
    for: dimension <= column <= 2 * dimension
        real64[] solution := [for i := (0:<int(dimension))[] then 0.0]
        row := dimension - 1
        while row >= 0
            current := augmented[row][column]
            for: row + 1 <= j < dimension
                current -= augmented[row][j] * solution[j]
            solution[row] = current / augmented[row][row]
            row -= 1
        solutions = solutions.append(solution)
    coefficients := solutions[0]
    inverse := [for row := (0:<int(dimension))[] then [for column := (0:<int(dimension))[] then solutions[column + 1][row]]]
    real64[] amplitudes := []
    real64[] phases := []
    for: k < int(#speeds)
        a := coefficients[2 * k + 1]
        b := coefficients[2 * k + 2]
        amplitude := math.sqrt(a * a + b * b)
        amplitudes = amplitudes.append(amplitude)
        phases = phases.append(phase(a, b))
    return Model(coefficients, inverse, amplitudes, phases)

import math

string[] selection_reason_names()
    return ["usable", "absent", "na", "flat", "spike", "mixed"]
int[] doodson_weights()
    return [0, 2, 1, 1, 2, 0, 1, 1, 0, 2, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1]
string[] comparison_constituents()
    return ["M2", "S2", "K1", "O1"]

real64 absolute(real64 value)
    return if value < 0.0 then -value else value

int integer_absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

real64 total(real64[] values)
    if #values == 0
        return 0.0
    result := values[0]
    for: 1 <= i < int(#values)
        result += values[i]
    return result

real64 mean(real64[] values)
    return total(values) / real64(#values)

real64 rms(real64[] values)
    result := math.sqrt(total([for value := values[] then value * value]) / real64(#values))
    return result

int largest(real64[] values)
    best := 0
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] > values[best]
            best = i
    return best

int smallest(real64[] values)
    best := 0
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] < values[best]
            best = i
    return best

class Selection(int[] indices, string[] statuses, string[] names, real64[] speeds)

Selection select_constituents(records.Constituent[] constituents, int duration, real64 rayleigh)
    int[] indices := []
    string[] statuses := []
    limit := 360.0 * rayleigh
    for: i < int(#constituents)
        speed := constituents[i].speed
        status := "fitted"
        if speed * real64(duration) < limit
            status = "short"
        else
            for j := indices[]
                if absolute(speed - constituents[j].speed) * real64(duration) < limit
                    status = "conflict:" + constituents[j].name
                    break
        statuses = statuses.append(status)
        if status == "fitted"
            indices = indices.append(i)
    return Selection(indices, statuses, [for i := indices[] then constituents[i].name], [for i := indices[] then constituents[i].speed])

int named_index(string[] names, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#names)
        if names[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

class Constant(string name, real64 speed, real64 amplitude, real64 phase, real64 amplitude_error, real64 phase_error, real64 snr)

Constant[] fitted_constants(Selection selection, harmonic_fit.Model model, real64 variance)
    Constant[] constants := []
    for: k < int(#selection.indices)
        ia := 2 * k + 1
        ib := 2 * k + 2
        a := model.coefficients[ia]
        b := model.coefficients[ib]
        amplitude := model.amplitudes[k]
        va := variance * model.inverse[ia][ia]
        vb := variance * model.inverse[ib][ib]
        cab := variance * model.inverse[ia][ib]
        amplitude_root := math.sqrt(a * a * va + b * b * vb + 2.0 * a * b * cab)
        phase_root := math.sqrt(b * b * va + a * a * vb - 2.0 * a * b * cab)
        amplitude_error := amplitude_root / amplitude
        real64 phase_error := phase_root / (amplitude * amplitude) * 180.0 / harmonic_fit.pi
        ratio := amplitude / amplitude_error
        constants = constants.append(Constant(selection.names[k], selection.speeds[k], amplitude, model.phases[k], amplitude_error, phase_error, ratio * ratio))
    return constants

class Extremum(bool high, int minute, real64 level, int day, string label)

Extremum[] prepare_extrema(predict.Extremum[] raw, real64 minimum_range)
    remaining := raw
    while #remaining >= 2
        best := 0
        minimum := absolute(remaining[0].level - remaining[1].level)
        for: 1 <= i < int(#remaining) - 1
            difference := absolute(remaining[i].level - remaining[i + 1].level)
            if difference < minimum
                minimum = difference
                best = i
        if minimum >= minimum_range
            break
        remaining = remaining[0:<best].concat(remaining[best + 2:<int(#remaining)])
    Extremum[] extrema := []
    for item := remaining[]
        minute := math.floor(item.minute + 0.5)
        extrema = extrema.append(Extremum(item.high, minute, item.level, minute / 1440, ""))
    first := 0
    while first < int(#extrema)
        last := first + 1
        while last < int(#extrema) and extrema[last].day == extrema[first].day
            last += 1
        high := -1
        low := -1
        for: first <= i < last
            if extrema[i].high
                if high < 0 or extrema[i].level > extrema[high].level
                    high = i
            else
                if low < 0 or extrema[i].level < extrema[low].level
                    low = i
        for: first <= i < last
            extrema[i].label = if extrema[i].high then (if i == high then "HHW" else "LHW") else (if i == low then "LLW" else "HLW")
        first = last
    return extrema

class Daily(int day, int[] highs, int[] lows, int highest, int lowest)

Daily[] daily_table(Extremum[] extrema, int start, int hours)
    Daily[] days := []
    for: i < hours / 24
        day := start / 24 + i
        int[] highs := []
        int[] lows := []
        highest := -1
        lowest := -1
        for: j < int(#extrema)
            if extrema[j].day != day
                continue
            if extrema[j].high
                highs = highs.append(j)
                if highest < 0 or extrema[j].level > extrema[highest].level
                    highest = j
            else
                lows = lows.append(j)
                if lowest < 0 or extrema[j].level < extrema[lowest].level
                    lowest = j
        days = days.append(Daily(day, highs, lows, highest, lowest))
    return days

class DailyMean(int day, real64 level, int filled)

DailyMean[] daily_means(int first, int last, real64[] values, real64[] fitted, int[] reasons)
    doodson := doodson_weights()
    DailyMean[] days := []
    for: first / 24 <= day <= last / 24
        noon := day * 24 + 12
        if noon - 19 < first or noon + 19 > last
            continue
        real64[] terms := []
        filled := 0
        for: -19 <= j <= 19
            t := noon + j
            level := if reasons[t] == 0 then values[t] else fitted[t]
            terms = terms.append(real64(doodson[integer_absolute(j)]) * level)
            if reasons[t] != 0
                filled += 1
        days = days.append(DailyMean(day, total(terms) / 30.0, filled))
    return days

class Event(int first, int last, int peak, bool positive)

Event[] residual_events(int[] usable, real64[] residuals, real64 threshold, int minimum_duration)
    Event[] events := []
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#usable)
        start := usable[cursor]
        value := residuals[start]
        if absolute(value) <= threshold
            cursor += 1
            continue
        positive := value > threshold
        last := start
        peak := start
        while cursor + 1 < int(#usable)
            next := usable[cursor + 1]
            same := if positive then residuals[next] > threshold else residuals[next] < -threshold
            if next != last + 1 or not same
                break
            cursor += 1
            last = next
            if (positive and residuals[last] > residuals[peak]) or (not positive and residuals[last] < residuals[peak])
                peak = last
        if last - start + 1 >= minimum_duration
            events = events.append(Event(start, last, peak, positive))
        cursor += 1
    return events

class Datums(real64 mhhw, real64 mhw, real64 mtl, real64 dtl, real64 mlw, real64 mllw, real64 mn, real64 gt)
class Characteristics(Datums datums, real64 form_number, string tide_type, real64 spring, real64 neap, real64 hat, real64 lat, int[] highs, int[] lows, int highest, int lowest, int widest, int narrowest, real64 above, real64 below, real64 rise_minutes, real64 fall_minutes, real64 m4_ratio, real64 relative_phase, string dominance)

Characteristics tidal_characteristics(Selection selection, harmonic_fit.Model model, Extremum[] extrema, Daily[] days, real64[] hourly)
    m2 := named_index(selection.names, "M2")
    s2 := named_index(selection.names, "S2")
    k1 := named_index(selection.names, "K1")
    o1 := named_index(selection.names, "O1")
    m4 := named_index(selection.names, "M4")
    amplitudes := model.amplitudes
    form_number := (amplitudes[k1] + amplitudes[o1]) / (amplitudes[m2] + amplitudes[s2])
    tide_type := if form_number < 0.25 then "semidiurnal" elif form_number < 1.5 then "mixed_semidiurnal" elif form_number < 3.0 then "mixed_diurnal" else "diurnal"
    highs := [for i := (0:<int(#extrema))[] if extrema[i].high then i]
    lows := [for i := (0:<int(#extrema))[] if not extrema[i].high then i]
    mhw := mean([for i := highs[] then extrema[i].level])
    mlw := mean([for i := lows[] then extrema[i].level])
    mhhw := mean([for day := days[] if day.highest >= 0 then extrema[day.highest].level])
    mllw := mean([for day := days[] if day.lowest >= 0 then extrema[day.lowest].level])
    datums := Datums(mhhw, mhw, (mhw + mlw) / 2.0, (mhhw + mllw) / 2.0, mlw, mllw, mhw - mlw, mhhw - mllw)
    highest := highs[largest([for i := highs[] then extrema[i].level])]
    lowest := lows[smallest([for i := lows[] then extrema[i].level])]
    complete_days := [for i := (0:<int(#days))[] if days[i].highest >= 0 and days[i].lowest >= 0 then i]
    ranges := [for i := complete_days[] then extrema[days[i].highest].level - extrema[days[i].lowest].level]
    widest := complete_days[largest(ranges)]
    narrowest := complete_days[smallest(ranges)]
    above := int(#[for value := hourly[] if value > mhhw then value])
    below := int(#[for value := hourly[] if value < mllw then value])
    real64[] rises := []
    real64[] falls := []
    for: 1 <= i < int(#extrema)
        if not extrema[i - 1].high and extrema[i].high
            rises = rises.append(real64(extrema[i].minute - extrema[i - 1].minute))
        elif extrema[i - 1].high and not extrema[i].high
            falls = falls.append(real64(extrema[i].minute - extrema[i - 1].minute))
    relative := 2.0 * model.phases[m2] - model.phases[m4]
    while relative < 0.0
        relative += 360.0
    while relative >= 360.0
        relative -= 360.0
    amplitude_sum := total(amplitudes)
    return Characteristics(datums, form_number, tide_type, 2.0 * (amplitudes[m2] + amplitudes[s2]), 2.0 * (amplitudes[m2] - amplitudes[s2]), model.coefficients[0] + amplitude_sum, model.coefficients[0] - amplitude_sum,
        highs, lows, highest, lowest, widest, narrowest, 100.0 * real64(above) / real64(#hourly), 100.0 * real64(below) / real64(#hourly), mean(rises), mean(falls), amplitudes[m4] / amplitudes[m2], relative, if relative < 180.0 then "flood" else "ebb")

int[] strongest(int[] times, real64[] residuals, int limit)
    int[] order := []
    for t := times[]
        position := int(#order)
        for: i < int(#order)
            if absolute(residuals[t]) > absolute(residuals[order[i]])
                position = i
                break
        order = order[0:<position].concat([t]).concat(order[position:<int(#order)])
        if int(#order) > limit
            order = order[0:<limit]
    return order

class Station(records.Station source, records.Params params, records.Constituent[] constituents)
    int capacity := source.observations[-1].hour + 1
    bool[] present := [for i := (0:<int(capacity))[] then false]
    numeric := present
    int[] millimetres := [for i := (0:<int(capacity))[] then 0]
    real64[] values := [for i := (0:<int(capacity))[] then 0.0]
    for observation := source.observations[]
        present[observation.hour] = true
        numeric[observation.hour] = observation.numeric
        millimetres[observation.hour] = observation.value
        values[observation.hour] = real64(observation.value) / 1000.0
    cleaning.Prepared cleaned := cleaning.prepare_record(present, numeric, millimetres, params.flat_run)
    int first := cleaned.first
    int last := cleaned.last
    duration := last - first
    Selection selection := select_constituents(constituents, duration, params.rayleigh)
    harmonic_fit.Model preliminary := harmonic_fit.fit(values, cleaned.candidates, selection.speeds)
    real64[] preliminary_residuals := [for i := (0:<int(capacity))[] then 0.0]
    for t := cleaned.candidates[]
        preliminary_residuals[t] = values[t] - predict.height(selection.speeds, preliminary.coefficients, real64(t))
    real64 prefit_rms := rms([for t := cleaned.candidates[] then preliminary_residuals[t]])
    cleaning.Tests spike_tests := cleaning.detect_spikes(cleaned.candidates, preliminary_residuals, params.spike_window, params.spike_minimum, params.spike_factor, params.spike_floor)
    int[] reasons := cleaned.reasons
    for spike := spike_tests.spikes[]
        reasons[spike.hour] = 4
    int[] usable := [for t := cleaned.candidates[] if reasons[t] == 0 then t]
    harmonic_fit.Model model := harmonic_fit.fit(values, usable, selection.speeds)
    real64[] fitted := [for t := (0:<int(capacity))[] then predict.height(selection.speeds, model.coefficients, real64(t))]
    real64[] residuals := [for t := (0:<int(capacity))[] then values[t] - fitted[t]]
    n := int(#usable)
    unknowns := int(#model.coefficients)
    dof := n - unknowns
    real64 ss := total([for t := usable[] then residuals[t] * residuals[t]])
    variance := ss / real64(dof)
    real64 residual_rms := rms([for t := usable[] then residuals[t]])
    real64 max_abs := absolute(residuals[strongest(usable, residuals, 1)[0]])
    real64 observed_mean := mean([for t := usable[] then values[t]])
    real64 observed_ss := total([for t := usable[] then (values[t] - observed_mean) * (values[t] - observed_mean)])
    explained := 100.0 * (1.0 - ss / observed_ss)
    int[] lag_times := [for t := usable[] if t + 1 <= last and reasons[t + 1] == 0 then t]
    real64 lag_numerator := total([for t := lag_times[] then residuals[t] * residuals[t + 1]])
    real64 lag_denominator := total([for t := lag_times[] then residuals[t] * residuals[t]])
    lag1 := lag_numerator / lag_denominator
    constants := fitted_constants(selection, model, variance)
    int[] top_times := strongest(usable, residuals, params.top_residuals)
    split := first + duration / 2
    int[] training := [for t := usable[] if t <= split then t]
    int[] testing := [for t := usable[] if t > split then t]
    Selection validation_selection := select_constituents(constituents, training[-1] - training[0], params.rayleigh)
    harmonic_fit.Model validation_model := harmonic_fit.fit(values, training, validation_selection.speeds)
    real64[] validation_residuals := [for t := testing[] then values[t] - predict.height(validation_selection.speeds, validation_model.coefficients, real64(t))]
    validation_rms := rms(validation_residuals)
    real64 in_sample_rms := rms([for t := testing[] then residuals[t]])
    real64 test_mean := mean([for t := testing[] then values[t]])
    real64 validation_ss := total([for value := validation_residuals[] then value * value])
    real64 test_ss := total([for t := testing[] then (values[t] - test_mean) * (values[t] - test_mean)])
    skill := 1.0 - validation_ss / test_ss
    Event[] events := residual_events(usable, residuals, params.surge_threshold, params.surge_hours)
    daily_levels := daily_means(first, last, values, fitted, reasons)
    real64[] mean_values := [for day := daily_levels[] then day.level]
    mean_level := mean(mean_values)
    real64[] mean_dates := [for day := daily_levels[] then real64(day.day - daily_levels[0].day)]
    mean_date := mean(mean_dates)
    real64 slope_numerator := total([for i := (0:<int(#daily_levels))[] then (mean_dates[i] - mean_date) * (mean_values[i] - mean_level)])
    real64 slope_denominator := total([for value := mean_dates[] then (value - mean_date) * (value - mean_date)])
    slope := 1000.0 * (slope_numerator / slope_denominator)
    daily_max := largest(mean_values)
    daily_min := smallest(mean_values)
    real64[] hourly := predict.hours(selection.speeds, model.coefficients, params.prediction_start, params.prediction_hours)
    predict.Extremum[] raw_extrema := predict.grid_extrema(selection.speeds, model.coefficients, params.prediction_start, params.prediction_hours, params.grid_minutes)
    Extremum[] extrema := prepare_extrema(raw_extrema, params.min_range)
    Daily[] days := daily_table(extrema, params.prediction_start, params.prediction_hours)
    characteristics := tidal_characteristics(selection, model, extrema, days, hourly)

    string hour_text(int t)
        return records.datetime_at_hour(params.epoch, t)

    string minute_text(int m)
        return records.datetime_at_minute(params.epoch, m)

    string day_text(int d)
        return records.date_at_minute(params.epoch, 1440 * d)

    string[] cleaning_lines()
        reason_names := selection_reason_names()
        counts := [for reason := (0:<5)[] then int(#[for t := (int(first):<(int(last) + 1))[] if reasons[t] == reason then t])]
        string[] lines := ["station={source.code} name={source.name}", "span start=" + hour_text(first) + " end=" + hour_text(last) + " hours={duration + 1} record_length={duration}",
            "counts rows={#source.observations} numeric={#cleaned.numeric_times} na={counts[2]} absent={counts[1]} flat={counts[3]} spikes={counts[4]} usable={n}"]
        for flat_run := cleaned.flat_runs[]
            lines = lines.append("flat start=" + hour_text(flat_run.first) + " end=" + hour_text(flat_run.last) + " value=" + report.fmt(real64(flat_run.value) / 1000.0, 3) + " removed={flat_run.last - flat_run.first}")
        lines = lines.append("spike_test window={params.spike_window} candidates={#cleaned.candidates} tested={spike_tests.tested} prefit_rms=" + report.fmt(prefit_rms, 4))
        for spike := spike_tests.spikes[]

real64 mean_lag(Station station, Station reference, bool high)
    own := if high then station.characteristics.highs else station.characteristics.lows
    other := if high then reference.characteristics.highs else reference.characteristics.lows
    real64[] differences := []
    for index := own[]
        minute := station.extrema[index].minute
        closest := other[0]
        distance := integer_absolute(minute - reference.extrema[closest].minute)
        for candidate := other[]
            separation := integer_absolute(minute - reference.extrema[candidate].minute)
            if separation < distance
                distance = separation
                closest = candidate
        differences = differences.append(real64(minute - reference.extrema[closest].minute))
    return mean(differences)

string[] comparison_lines(Station[] stations, records.Params params)
    compared_names := comparison_constituents()
    reference_index := 0
    for: i < int(#stations)
        if stations[i].source.code == params.reference
            reference_index = i
    reference := stations[reference_index]
    lines := ["[comparison] reference={params.reference}"]
    for: i < int(#stations)
        if i == reference_index
            continue
        station := stations[i]
        range_ratio := station.characteristics.datums.gt / reference.characteristics.datums.gt
        mtl_difference := station.characteristics.datums.mtl - reference.characteristics.datums.mtl
        lines = lines.append("{station.source.code} tide hw_lag_min=" + report.fmt(mean_lag(station, reference, true), 1) + " lw_lag_min=" + report.fmt(mean_lag(station, reference, false), 1) + " range_ratio=" + report.fmt(range_ratio, 4) + " mtl_diff=" + report.fmt(mtl_difference, 3))
        for name := compared_names[]
            own := station.constants[named_index(station.selection.names, name)]
            other := reference.constants[named_index(reference.selection.names, name)]
            phase_difference := own.phase - other.phase
            if phase_difference > 180.0
                phase_difference -= 360.0
            if phase_difference <= -180.0
                phase_difference += 360.0
            lag := phase_difference / own.speed * 60.0
            lines = lines.append("{station.source.code} {name} amplitude_ratio=" + report.fmt(own.amplitude / other.amplitude, 4) + " phase_diff=" + report.fmt(phase_difference, 2) + " time_lag_min=" + report.fmt(lag, 1))
    return lines

class Correlation(int lag, int pairs, real64 value)

Correlation correlate(Station first, Station second, int lag)
    real64[] xs := []
    real64[] ys := []
    for t := first.usable[]
        u := t + lag
        if u >= 0 and u < second.capacity and second.reasons[u] == 0
            xs = xs.append(first.residuals[t])
            ys = ys.append(second.residuals[u])
    mx := mean(xs)
    my := mean(ys)
    sxy := total([for i := (0:<int(#xs))[] then (xs[i] - mx) * (ys[i] - my)])
    sxx := total([for x := xs[] then (x - mx) * (x - mx)])
    syy := total([for y := ys[] then (y - my) * (y - my)])
    denominator := math.sqrt(sxx * syy)
    return Correlation(lag, int(#xs), sxy / denominator)

string[] correlation_lines(Station[] stations, int maximum_lag)
    lines := ["[correlation] max_lag={maximum_lag}"]
    for: a < int(#stations)
        for: a + 1 <= b < int(#stations)
            best := correlate(stations[a], stations[b], -maximum_lag)
            real64 lag0 := 0.0
            for: -maximum_lag <= lag <= maximum_lag
                current := correlate(stations[a], stations[b], lag)
                if lag == 0
                    lag0 = current.value
                preferred := integer_absolute(lag) < integer_absolute(best.lag) or (integer_absolute(lag) == integer_absolute(best.lag) and lag < best.lag)
                if current.value > best.value or (current.value == best.value and preferred)
                    best = current
            lines = lines.append("{stations[a].source.code}-{stations[b].source.code} lag0=" + report.fmt(lag0, 4) + " best_lag={best.lag} best=" + report.fmt(best.value, 4) + " pairs={best.pairs}")
    return lines

string[] plot_lines(Station station, records.Params params)
    rows := (params.plot_top - params.plot_bottom) / params.plot_step + 1
    cells := [for row := (0:<int(rows))[] then [for column := (0:<int(params.plot_hours))[] then " "]]
    zero_position := (real64(params.plot_top) - 100.0 * station.model.coefficients[0]) / real64(params.plot_step) + 0.5
    zero_row := math.floor(zero_position)
    if zero_row >= 0 and zero_row < rows
        cells[zero_row] = [for column := (0:<int(params.plot_hours))[] then "-"]
    marks := [for column := (0:<int(params.plot_hours))[] then "*"]
    for item := station.extrema[]
        column := (item.minute - 60 * params.prediction_start + 30) / 60
        if column >= 0 and column < params.plot_hours
            marks[column] = if item.high then "H" else "L"
    for: column < params.plot_hours
        position := (real64(params.plot_top) - 100.0 * station.hourly[column]) / real64(params.plot_step) + 0.5
        row := math.floor(position)
        if row < 0
            cells[0][column] = "^"
        elif row >= rows
            cells[rows - 1][column] = "v"
        else
            cells[row][column] = marks[column]
    lines := ["[plot] station={params.plot_code} start=" + records.datetime_at_hour(params.epoch, params.prediction_start) + " hours={params.plot_hours} step_cm={params.plot_step}"]
    return lines.concat(report.plot_lines(params.plot_top, params.plot_step, cells))

void run()
    input_data := records.read_inputs()
    records.Params params := input_data.params
    stations := [for source := input_data.stations[] then Station(source, params, input_data.constituents)]
    string[] cleaning_rows := []
    constituent_rows := ["station,constituent,speed,status,amplitude,phase,amplitude_error,phase_error,snr,significant"]
    string[] extremes_rows := []
    string[] summary_rows := []
    for station := stations[]
        cleaning_rows = cleaning_rows.concat(station.cleaning_lines())
        constituent_rows = constituent_rows.concat(station.constituent_lines())
        extremes_rows = extremes_rows.concat(station.extreme_lines())
        summary_rows = summary_rows.concat(station.summary_lines())
    header := "time" + [for station := stations[] then "," + station.source.code].join("")
    predictions := [header]
    for: i <= params.prediction_hours
        instant := records.datetime_at_hour(params.epoch, params.prediction_start + i)
        predictions = predictions.append(instant + [for station := stations[] then "," + report.fmt(station.hourly[i], 3)].join(""))
    summary_rows = summary_rows.concat(comparison_lines(stations, params)).concat(correlation_lines(stations, params.correlation_lag))
    for station := stations[]
        if station.source.code == params.plot_code
            summary_rows = summary_rows.concat(plot_lines(station, params))
    report.write("cleaning.txt", cleaning_rows)
    report.write("constituents.csv", constituent_rows)
    report.write("predictions.csv", predictions)
    report.write("extremes.txt", extremes_rows)
    report.write("summary.txt", summary_rows)

run()

import math
import harmonic_fit = "./harmonic_fit.qui"

real64 height(real64[] speeds, real64[] coefficients, real64 hour)
    result := coefficients[0]
    for: k < int(#speeds)
        theta := harmonic_fit.angle(speeds[k], hour)
        result += coefficients[2 * k + 1] * math.cos(theta) + coefficients[2 * k + 2] * math.sin(theta)
    return result

real64[] hours(real64[] speeds, real64[] coefficients, int start, int count)
    return [for i := (0:<(int(count) + 1))[] then height(speeds, coefficients, real64(start + i))]

class Extremum(bool high, real64 minute, real64 level)

Extremum[] grid_extrema(real64[] speeds, real64[] coefficients, int start, int duration, int spacing)
    count := duration * 60 / spacing
    minutes := [for i := (0:<(int(count) + 1))[] then 60 * start + i * spacing]
    heights := [for minute := minutes[] then height(speeds, coefficients, real64(minute) / 60.0)]
    Extremum[] extrema := []
    for: 1 <= j < count
        left := heights[j - 1]
        center := heights[j]
        right := heights[j + 1]
        high := left < center and center > right
        low := left > center and center < right
        if not high and not low
            continue
        delta := (left - right) / (2.0 * (left - 2.0 * center + right))
        minute := real64(minutes[j]) + delta * real64(spacing)
        level := center - (left - right) * delta / 4.0
        extrema = extrema.append(Extremum(high, minute, level))
    return extrema

int integer(string text)
    value := int(text)
    return value

real64 number(string text)
    value := real64(text)
    return value

string[] lines(string path)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    rows := text.split(NL)
    return rows[0:<int(#rows) - 1]

bool leap(int year)
    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)

int[] month_lengths(int year)
    return [31, if leap(year) then 29 else 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]

int ordinal(int year, int month, int day)
    previous := year - 1
    result := 365 * previous + previous / 4 - previous / 100 + previous / 400 + day - 1
    months := month_lengths(year)
    for: m < month - 1
        result += months[m]
    return result

int absolute_minute(string text)
    year := integer(text[0:<4])
    month := integer(text[5:<7])
    day := integer(text[8:<10])
    hour := integer(text[11:<13])
    minute := integer(text[14:<16])
    return ordinal(year, month, day) * 1440 + hour * 60 + minute

string padded(int value, int width)
    text := string(value)
    return "0" * nat(width - int(#text)) + text

string datetime_at_minute(int epoch, int minute)
    instant := epoch + minute
    day := instant / 1440
    within := instant % 1440
    year := day / 365 + 1
    while ordinal(year, 1, 1) > day
        year -= 1
    while ordinal(year + 1, 1, 1) <= day
        year += 1
    remaining := day - ordinal(year, 1, 1)
    months := month_lengths(year)
    month := 0
    while remaining >= months[month]
        remaining -= months[month]
        month += 1
    return padded(year, 4) + "-" + padded(month + 1, 2) + "-" + padded(remaining + 1, 2) + " " + padded(within / 60, 2) + ":" + padded(within % 60, 2)

string datetime_at_hour(int epoch, int hour)
    return datetime_at_minute(epoch, 60 * hour)

string date_at_minute(int epoch, int minute)
    return datetime_at_minute(epoch, minute)[0:<10]

int millimetres(string text)
    negative := text[0] == "-"
    magnitude := if negative then text[1:<int(#text)] else text
    parts := magnitude.split(".")
    result := 1000 * integer(parts[0]) + integer(parts[1])
    return if negative then -result else result

class Observation(int hour, bool numeric, int value)
class Station(string code, string name, Observation[] observations)
class Constituent(string name, real64 speed)
class Params(int epoch, string reference, int flat_run, int spike_window, int spike_minimum, real64 spike_factor, real64 spike_floor, real64 rayleigh, real64 snr_min, int top_residuals, real64 surge_threshold, int surge_hours, int prediction_start, int prediction_hours, int grid_minutes, real64 min_range, int correlation_lag, string plot_code, int plot_hours, int plot_top, int plot_bottom, int plot_step)
class Input(Params params, Station[] stations, Constituent[] constituents)

Input read_inputs()
    rows := lines("input/params.txt")
    epoch := absolute_minute(rows[0][6:<int(#rows[0])])
    Station[] stations := []
    cursor := 1
    while rows[cursor][0:<8] == "station "
        fields := rows[cursor].split(" ")
        stations = stations.append(Station(fields[1], fields[2:<int(#fields)].join(" "), []))
        cursor += 1
    settings := [for row := rows[cursor:<int(#rows)][] then row.split(" ")]
    prediction_start := (absolute_minute(settings[7][1] + " " + settings[7][2]) - epoch) / 60
    params := Params(epoch, settings[0][1], integer(settings[1][1]), integer(settings[2][1]), integer(settings[2][2]), number(settings[2][3]), number(settings[2][4]), number(settings[3][1]), number(settings[4][1]), integer(settings[5][1]), number(settings[6][1]), integer(settings[6][2]), prediction_start, integer(settings[7][3]), integer(settings[8][1]), number(settings[9][1]), integer(settings[10][1]), settings[11][1], integer(settings[11][2]), integer(settings[11][3]), integer(settings[11][4]), integer(settings[11][5]))
    Constituent[] constituents := []
    rows = lines("input/constituents.txt")
    for row := rows[1:<int(#rows)][]
        fields := row.split(" ")
        constituents = constituents.append(Constituent(fields[0], number(fields[1])))
    rows = lines("input/observations.csv")
    for row := rows[1:<int(#rows)][]
        fields := row.split(",")
        hour := (absolute_minute(fields[1]) - epoch) / 60
        numeric := fields[2] != "NA"
        observation := Observation(hour, numeric, if numeric then millimetres(fields[2]) else 0)
        for: i < int(#stations)
            if stations[i].code == fields[0]
                stations[i].observations = stations[i].observations.append(observation)
                break
    return Input(params, stations, constituents)

import math

string fmt(real64 value, int places)
    factor := 10 ^ places
    magnitude := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    rounded := math.floor(magnitude * real64(factor) + 0.5)
    tail := string(rounded % factor)
    sign := if value < 0.0 and rounded != 0 then "-" else ""
    return sign + string(rounded / factor) + "." + "0" * nat(places - int(#tail)) + tail

void write(string name, string[] rows)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)

string[] plot_lines(int top, int step, string[][] cells)

    width := 0

        if int(#label) > width
            width = int(#label)
    string[] lines := []
    for: row < int(#cells)
        lines = lines.append(" " * nat(width - int(#labels[row])) + labels[row] + " |" + cells[row].join("") + "|")
    ticks := [for column := (0:<int(#cells[0]))[] then (if column % 6 == 0 then "+" else "-")].join("")
    return lines.append(" " * nat(width + 1) + "+" + ticks + "+")
